items.headline: Supplier emissions reporting becomes more specific
items.what_happened: A synthetic company filing adds product-level emissions fields to its supplier requirements.
items.why_it_matters: More specific data can make transition claims easier for an analyst to verify.
items.watch_next: Whether suppliers publish comparable methods and assurance statements.

items.headline: Grid investment moves from target to procurement
items.what_happened: A synthetic news item describes a utility opening bids for transmission upgrades.
items.why_it_matters: Procurement is a more concrete demand signal than a long-range capital target.
items.watch_next: Award timing, allowed returns, and equipment lead times.

items.headline: Water risk appears in an operating update
items.what_happened: A sample issuer flags water availability as a constraint at two facilities.
items.why_it_matters: A physical risk becomes financially relevant when it affects capacity or cost.
items.watch_next: Mitigation spending and changes to production guidance.

sustainable.title: Companies and capital
sustainable.purpose: How companies are funding and executing change.

items.headline: Transition project reaches a financing milestone
items.what_happened: A demonstration project secures USD 4.2 billion of committed financing.
items.why_it_matters: Committed capital lowers execution uncertainty but does not remove construction risk.
items.watch_next: Conditions before funds can be drawn and the sponsor equity contribution.

items.headline: Capital plan separates maintenance from transition spend
items.what_happened: A sample investor presentation reports the two spending categories independently.
items.why_it_matters: The split shows what preserves the business and what may reshape it.
items.watch_next: Whether management reports returns for each category.

items.headline: Sustainability-linked pricing becomes measurable
items.what_happened: A fixture credit agreement publishes a margin adjustment and a target test date.
items.why_it_matters: Specific terms make it possible to judge whether the incentive is meaningful.
items.watch_next: Independent verification and the cost if the target is missed.

sustainable.title: Policy, markets and risks
sustainable.purpose: External changes that may alter the business case.

items.headline: Disclosure timetable creates a data checkpoint
items.what_happened: A sample policy update clarifies when covered companies must report selected metrics.
items.why_it_matters: A firm date tells the analyst when comparable evidence may become available.
items.watch_next: Scope exemptions and implementation guidance.

items.headline: Carbon-market activity rises while pricing stays uneven
items.what_happened: A synthetic market report shows more trading but wide differences by contract type.
items.why_it_matters: Volume alone does not prove a reliable price signal.
items.watch_next: Contract quality rules and concentration among buyers.

items.headline: Insurance renewal highlights physical-risk costs
items.what_happened: A fixture update reports higher insurance premiums for exposed assets.
items.why_it_matters: Insurance can translate a broad climate risk into an observable operating cost.
items.watch_next: Deductibles, exclusions, and resilience spending.

consumer.title: Consumer demand signals
consumer.purpose: What households are buying and where demand is changing.

items.headline: Households trade down in one category, not everywhere
items.what_happened: A demo retailer reports more private-label grocery purchases while premium beauty holds up.
items.why_it_matters: A single consumer-strength headline can hide important category differences.
items.watch_next: Unit volumes, basket size, and repeat purchases.

items.headline: Promotions lift traffic but pressure margins
items.what_happened: A sample earnings update links higher store visits to deeper discounting.
items.why_it_matters: Sales growth is less valuable when a company gives up profit to generate it.
items.watch_next: Whether promotions persist after seasonal inventory clears.

items.headline: Services spending remains firmer than goods
items.what_happened: A fixture report shows travel and entertainment outpacing discretionary goods.
items.why_it_matters: Category rotation can create winners even when total household budgets are stable.
items.watch_next: Booking windows and cancellation rates.

consumer.title: Companies and brands
consumer.purpose: How management teams respond through price, product, and inventory.

items.headline: Brand resets prices after an elasticity test
items.what_happened: A demonstration filing says selected price increases reduced unit demand more than expected.
items.why_it_matters: Price elasticity describes how demand changes when price changes and affects growth quality.
items.watch_next: Volume recovery and competitor reactions.

items.headline: Inventory discipline releases working capital
items.what_happened: A sample retailer reduces seasonal inventory by USD 950 million year over year.
items.why_it_matters: Less cash tied up in inventory can strengthen near-term financial flexibility.
items.watch_next: Whether leaner stock causes missed sales.

items.headline: Loyalty data becomes central to advertising strategy
items.what_happened: A fixture presentation expands a retail-media program using purchase data.
items.why_it_matters: The revenue stream may carry higher margins but raises privacy questions.
items.watch_next: Advertiser retention and data-consent controls.

consumer.title: Economy and risks
consumer.purpose: External pressures on household budgets and company outlooks.

items.headline: Credit costs diverge across consumer groups
items.what_happened: A demo report shows borrowing stress concentrated among lower-income cohorts.
items.why_it_matters: An average can look stable while the most exposed customers weaken.
items.watch_next: Delinquency transitions and lender underwriting changes.

items.headline: Freight relief reaches shelves unevenly
items.what_happened: A sample story finds lower transport costs passing through faster in some categories.
items.why_it_matters: Cost relief may support margins or lower prices depending on competition.
items.watch_next: Gross-margin guidance and category pricing gaps.

items.headline: Wage growth supports demand but keeps labor costs elevated
items.what_happened: A fixture analysis pairs stronger pay with persistent service-sector staffing costs.
items.why_it_matters: The same trend can help revenue and hurt margins.
items.watch_next: Hours worked, hiring plans, and price changes.

private-credit.title: Borrowers and deals
private-credit.purpose: New financings, refinancings, and borrower-level signals.

items.headline: Refinancing extends maturity but adds lender protection
items.what_happened: A demo borrower replaces a near-term maturity with tighter reporting terms.
items.why_it_matters: More time helps liquidity; added covenants show lenders still see risk.
items.watch_next: Cash interest coverage and covenant headroom.

items.headline: Unitranche financing backs a software acquisition
items.what_happened: A fixture deal combines senior and junior risk in one USD 1.1 billion private loan.
items.why_it_matters: A unitranche simplifies execution but concentrates negotiation with fewer lenders.
items.watch_next: Leverage, recurring revenue quality, and integration costs.

items.headline: Amend-and-extend trades price for time
items.what_happened: A sample borrower pays a higher spread to move its loan maturity out two years.
items.why_it_matters: The deal avoids an immediate refinancing wall but raises interest expense.
items.watch_next: Free cash flow after the higher coupon.

private-credit.title: Lenders and capital
private-credit.purpose: Fundraising, deployment, and competition among lenders.

items.headline: New fund closes above its predecessor
items.what_happened: A demonstration manager reports USD 6.5 billion of direct-lending commitments.
items.why_it_matters: More available capital can intensify competition for high-quality borrowers.
items.watch_next: Deployment pace and underwriting terms.

items.headline: Banks and private lenders share a financing
items.what_happened: A fixture transaction uses a bank-led revolver and private term debt.
items.why_it_matters: The markets can complement each other rather than always compete.
items.watch_next: Collateral priority and refinancing options.

items.headline: Portfolio marks hold as non-accruals edge up
items.what_happened: A sample lender reports slightly more loans that stopped paying cash interest.
items.why_it_matters: Stable valuations and weaker cash performance should be examined together.
items.watch_next: Realized losses, restructurings, and payment-in-kind income.

private-credit.title: Risk and market context
private-credit.purpose: Rates, documentation, defaults, and cross-market signals.

items.headline: Documentation loosens for top-tier borrowers
items.what_happened: A demo report finds fewer lender protections in competitive deals.
items.why_it_matters: Strong borrowers may win flexibility that leaves fewer early-warning triggers.
items.watch_next: Add-backs, debt baskets, and reporting frequency.

items.headline: Base-rate move changes the interest burden
items.what_happened: A fixture analysis estimates lower floating rates reduce annual borrower interest expense.
items.why_it_matters: Most private loans float, so rate changes reach cash flow relatively quickly.
items.watch_next: Rate floors and whether savings support debt paydown.

items.headline: Restructuring clusters in older vintages
items.what_happened: A sample report finds stress among deals underwritten before borrowing costs rose.
items.why_it_matters: Origination year can help explain leverage and documentation risk.
items.watch_next: Recovery values and sponsor support.
